parole.significato: Any distilled alcoholic liquor: vodka, whisky, brandy, etc.
parole.testo: Formed following the pattern of Polish gorzałka, and related to горі́ти (horíty, “to burn”), from Old East Slavic горѣти (gorěti, “to burn”), from Proto-Slavic *gorěti (“to burn”), from Proto-Indo-European *gʷʰer-, *gʷʰor- (“warm, hot”). It may be an abbreviation of a compound term, such as: * горі́
